items.summary: The recent $3.2tn sell-off in AI related assets after the US midterm elections showed how quickly sentiment can flip when investors worry about slower AI spending and tighter rules. items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Maps Out $650 Million Connecticut Center For Global Clinical Trials
items.summary: Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) plans to build a US$650 million manufacturing technology center in Connecticut to support global clinical trials. The planned facility is expected to produce clinical active pharmaceutical ingredients and drug products for Pfizer's development pipeline. Pfizer describes the project as a long term expansion of its R&D and supply chain capabilities tied to future portfolio needs.
